legs.note: Media verbs are tweaks — pausing is undone by pressing the same button. A closed tab is not. A write: the skill asks first, so the turn-level runner must answer the confirmation; the probe cannot dispatch a package-realized operation at all. Staged with a second tab: closing the only tab of a window closes the WINDOW, which is a different act and leaves the browser resolving to somebody else's.

summary: Closing a tab is the one write in this lane, so it asks first.
